tasks.title: Receipt template versioning + webpage builder (deterministic receipt regeneration)
tasks.details:
RE-SCOPED 2026-09-15 by user. Previous scope (receipt delivery via email/WhatsApp/SMS) folded into R-62e. New scope: receipt template versioning + webpage builder for deterministic receipt regeneration.

PROBLEM: All order/sale/rental data is stored in the DB. Receipts (HTML branded + plain-text printable) are generated on the fly from this data using a hardcoded template (receipts.html.js). Today the receipt is self-contained — it has all the data it needs. But if we add or remove fields from the receipt payload in the future, old receipts would render incorrectly or break entirely. There is no way to guarantee that a receipt generated today will still look correct next year.

GOAL: (1) Version receipt templates so each template change is tracked and frozen. (2) Map template versions to invoices/orders so at any point in time, generating a receipt uses the exact template that was active when the order was created. (3) Provide a visual webpage builder (using an open-source npm package) for designing receipt templates — must support JSON + HTML export/import, table formats, and inline CSS edits. (4) Capture a snapshot of each receipt at order time so it can be regenerated deterministically without re-rendering.

ARCHITECTURE:

1. NEW TABLES:
   - receipt_templates: id, name, version (integer), html_content (TEXT, the full HTML/CSS template with {{placeholders}}), block_layout (JSONB, the block arrangement for the builder), is_active (boolean, only one active at a time), created_by (FK users), created_at, updated_at.
   - receipt_snapshots: id, entity_type (SALE|RENTAL), entity_uuid (UUID), template_id (FK), template_version (integer), rendered_html (TEXT, the final frozen HTML), rendered_at (TIMESTAMP). Unique on (entity_type, entity_uuid) — one snapshot per order.

2. TEMPLATE BUILDER (webpage builder module):
   - Visual editor with draggable blocks: Header (logo + store name + tagline), Item Table (loop placeholder for line items), Field Row (label + dotted-line value), Text Block (free text), Image (logo/monogram), Divider, Footer (thank-you + signature).
   - Placeholder syntax: {{variable}} resolved at render time.
   - Available placeholders: {{store.name}}, {{store.address}}, {{store.phone}}, {{transaction.number}}, {{transaction.date}}, {{transaction.paymentMethod}}, {{customer.name}}, {{customer.phone}}, {{customer.email}}, {{items}} (loop start), {{/items}} (loop end), {{item.sno}}, {{item.productName}}, {{item.colour}}, {{item.size}}, {{item.quantity}}, {{item.unitPrice}}, {{item.lineTotal}}, {{totals.subtotal}}, {{totals.total}}, {{totals.amountInWords}}, {{totals.itemsCount}}.
   - Live preview panel: renders the template with sample data (hardcoded sample sale).
   - Save as new version: creates a new receipt_templates row with incremented version; old versions remain for historical receipts.
   - CSS is embedded in the template HTML (self-contained, like current branded receipt).

3. SNAPSHOT CAPTURE:
   - After sale/rental commits (in sales.service.js createSale / rental-agreement.service.js createRental), render receipt with the active template and store in receipt_snapshots.
   - delivery_logs.receipt_payload continues to store structured JSON (for email/WhatsApp via R-62).
   - receipt_snapshots.rendered_html stores the final HTML (for deterministic regeneration).

4. DETERMINISTIC REGENERATION:
   - To regenerate a single receipt: fetch receipt_snapshots.rendered_html directly — no re-render.
   - For bulk export (backup/transfer): query all snapshots, output HTML files named {sale_number}.html or {agreement_number}.html.
   - Template changes never affect old receipts because snapshots are frozen.

5. API ENDPOINTS:
   - GET /api/receipt-templates — list all templates (with version history)
   - POST /api/receipt-templates — create new template
   - PUT /api/receipt-templates/:id — update template (creates new version)
   - POST /api/receipt-templates/:id/activate — set as active template
   - GET /api/receipt-templates/active — get current active template
   - POST /api/receipt-templates/preview — render preview with sample data
   - GET /api/receipt-snapshots/:entityType/:entityUuid — get frozen receipt for an order
   - GET /api/receipt-snapshots/export — bulk export all snapshots (admin)

6. FRONTEND:
   - New screen: Receipt Templates (Admin section) — list templates, activate, open builder.
   - Template Builder: block-based visual editor with live preview (drag blocks, edit placeholder fields, preview with sample data).
   - Existing ReceiptSection gains a 'View original receipt' button that loads the snapshot.
   - Sale/Rental creation flow unchanged (snapshot captured silently in backend).

7. PERMISSIONS:
   - receipt_templates.view (ADMIN/MANAGER)
   - receipt_templates.manage (ADMIN only — create/edit/activate templates)
   - receipt_snapshots.view (ADMIN/MANAGER — view frozen receipts)
   - receipt_snapshots.export (ADMIN only — bulk export)

SEQUENCING:
  Phase 1: DB schema + template CRUD API + snapshot capture on sale/rental creation.
  Phase 2: Template builder UI (blocks + placeholders + live preview).
  Phase 3: Snapshot viewer + bulk export + integration with existing receipt components.

FILES AFFECTED:
  Backend new: receipt-templates/ module (controller, service, validation, routes), ReceiptTemplate.js model, ReceiptSnapshot.js model, 2 new migrations.
  Backend modified: receipts.service.js (add snapshot capture), sales.service.js (trigger snapshot), rental-agreement.service.js (trigger snapshot), permissions.js, app.js (mount routes).
  Frontend new: ReceiptTemplatesScreen.jsx, TemplateBuilder.jsx, receiptTemplateApi.js.
  Frontend modified: ReceiptSection.jsx (add View original), navigation.js (add nav item).

OPEN QUESTIONS (for user):
  1. Custom CSS in builder, or block-only (simpler)? ANSWERED: use an npm module, NOT custom-built. Must support tables and inline CSS edits. Candidates: react-email-editor (Unlayer), @bolttech/template-editor (Craft.js), email-block-builder.
  2. Snapshots store both JSON + HTML, or just HTML? ANSWERED: BOTH — structured JSON (receipt_payload JSONB) AND rendered HTML.
  3. Bulk export: HTML files or PDF (needs puppeteer)? ANSWERED: admin-triggered folder export by invoice number. Purpose: recovery if PDFs lost. HTML files; PDFs are large/expensive to backup.
  4. Multiple active templates (one per entity type) or one global? ANSWERED: TWO active templates — one for retail sales, one for rentals. Older iterations marked inactive but kept in DB for export-all-receipts.

PREVIOUS SCOPE (folded into R-62e): receipt delivery via email/WhatsApp/SMS at checkout. Delivery_logs + consent flags already exist. WhatsApp = wa.me hand-off; email = Brevo SMTP; SMS deferred. Architecture: async dispatch, provider-adapter layer, delivery_logs ledger, tokenized receipt page. OPEN DECISIONS answered in R-62 epic.R-47 rework (2026-09-16): [2026-09-16 ~09:45Z] SHIPPED on user go: committed (app-code commit + docs commit on context), pushed origin/context, app-code commit cherry-picked to origin/main + pushed. Root tree verified (backend receipt-templates module + migrations 20260916000001/2 + frontend TemplateBuilder/ReceiptTemplatesScreen/BrandedReceiptDialog/ReceiptSection/receiptTemplateApi). db:migrate/seed/refresh clean, backend jest 806, frontend vitest 436, build clean. Leave-alone untracked (colors.zip, colors/, frontend/doc/, tunnels.json) not committed. OPEN follow-up: visual diff vs physical-receipt photo (unreadable) = seed HTML tweak if the printed receipt differs.

humanQA.q: **R-47 has been re-scoped to receipt template versioning + webpage builder.** The previous delivery scope is folded into R-62e. New scope: version receipt templates, build a visual editor with placeholders, capture frozen snapshots at order time for deterministic regeneration. 4 open questions: (1) custom CSS or block-only builder? (2) snapshots store JSON+HTML or just HTML? (3) bulk export HTML or PDF? (4) one active template or per-entity-type? Please review and answer.
humanQA.a: All answered by user (2026-09-15): (1) Use an npm module for the builder — NOT custom-built. Must support tables and inline CSS edits. Candidates: react-email-editor (Unlayer), @bolttech/template-editor (Craft.js), email-block-builder. (2) Save BOTH structured JSON (receipt_payload) AND rendered HTML in receipt_snapshots. (3) Admin-triggered bulk export: exports receipt data into a folder keyed by invoice number. Purpose: if PDF data is lost, receipts can be regenerated from DB. (4) Two active templates: one for retail sales, one for rentals. Older iterations marked inactive but kept in DB for export-all-receipts.

tasks.title: Durable backups on the shop laptop: verified pg_dump twice daily (Task Scheduler) + manual encrypted upload to Google Drive via rclone + restore script; setup.ps1 registers it all
tasks.details:
USER: automatic local DB backup twice a day (times asked at setup, 24h format), a manually triggered backup that uploads the whole DB to the cloud (Google Drive, personal gmail, via rclone) into DATE-WISE folders, all registered by the initial setup script. HARD RULES: setup.ps1 has already been run on the laptop → every change must be backward compatible, idempotent, and a failing new step must never affect what is already installed and running (app, DB, .env, pm2, firewall, startup). Show the rclone encryption password ONCE at setup so the user saves it.

DESIGN:
- Backups live OUTSIDE the repo at C:\\IMPOC-backups\\{local,pre-update,cloud-staging}\\ so git/update.ps1 never see them. Shared helpers in deploy/windows/lib/backup-common.ps1 (Read-DotEnv, Find-PgTool, Invoke-VerifiedDump = pg_dump -Fc → pg_restore --list check → atomic rename, Write-BackupStatus JSON, Prune).
- backup-local.ps1/.cmd: verified dump → impoc-YYYY-MM-DD_HHmm.dump, prune >14 days, log + last-status.json; exit code non-zero on failure. Registered as two Windows scheduled tasks 'IMPOC backup 1/2' (Register-ScheduledTask, run when logged on — the laptop auto-logs in; StartWhenAvailable so a missed time runs at next boot).
- backup-cloud.ps1/.cmd (manual double-click; safe to schedule later): takes a fresh verified dump, uploads dump + backend\\.env with `rclone copy --checksum` to gdrive-crypt:YYYY/MM/DD/ (encrypted names+contents), prunes cloud copies >90 days, writes status; clear message if rclone/remote missing.
- restore-db.ps1: list local (and cloud) dumps, pick one, confirm by typing the DB name, stop pm2, pg_dump a safety copy, drop+create DB, pg_restore, migrate, restart pm2.
- setup.ps1: new final steps (each try/catch → Warn, never Fail): 10 backup folder + times prompt (24h HH:mm, validated; -BackupTimes param to skip prompt) + task registration; 11 rclone (-SkipCloud to bypass): install via winget or zip download to C:\\IMPOC\\rclone, `rclone config create gdrive drive scope drive.file` (browser sign-in), crypt remote gdrive-crypt → gdrive:IMPOC-backups with generated password+salt (rclone obscure), password shown ONCE + saved to C:\\IMPOC-backups\\CLOUD-PASSWORD-SAVE-ME.txt, connection test. Skips cleanly if already configured.
- update.ps1: pre-migration dump via the shared helper into C:\\IMPOC-backups\\pre-update.
- docs/WINDOWS_PRODUCTION_SETUP.md: Backups section (schedule, cloud, restore, token-reconnect chore). Hive docs updated.

VERIFY: PowerShell syntax check (pwsh parser) here; logic reviewed; user runs setup.cmd again on the laptop (idempotent) and reports.

BUILT 2026-09-14 (awaiting user run on the laptop): deploy/windows/lib/backup-common.ps1 (BackupRoot C:\\IMPOC-backups, env override; Read-DotEnv, Find-PgTool, Invoke-VerifiedDump = pg_dump -Fc → .partial → pg_restore --list must succeed + contain TABLE DATA → rename; Remove-OldDumps; Write-BackupStatus JSON (atomic tmp+move); Write-BackupLog monthly; Find-Rclone/Test-RcloneRemote), backup-local.ps1/.cmd (14-day retention, exit code), backup-cloud.ps1/.cmd (fresh dump → rclone copy --checksum to gdrive-crypt:YYYY/MM/DD + .env → config/backend.env, lsl confirms, delete --min-age 90d *.dump, rmdirs; token-expiry hint), restore-db.ps1 (local or -FromCloud pick, type-DB-name confirm, safety dump, pm2 stop, terminate connections, drop/create, pg_restore --exit-on-error, migrate, pm2 start; on failure prints the safety copy path). setup.ps1: params -BackupTimes 'HH:mm,HH:mm' + -SkipCloud; step 10 (folder, validated 24h prompt, two Register-ScheduledTask 'IMPOC database backup 1/2' daily, Interactive logon, StartWhenAvailable, first backup taken) and step 11 (rclone via winget or zip → C:\\IMPOC\\rclone; `config create gdrive drive scope drive.file` browser sign-in; crypt remote with New-Secret password+salt shown ONCE + CLOUD-BACKUP-PASSWORD-SAVE-ME.txt; mkdir+lsd test) — both try/catch → Warn, placed after pm2/firewall/startup; idempotent (skips existing remotes/tasks re-registered with -Force). update.ps1 pre-migration dump now uses the helper into pre-update/ (60-day prune). docs §8 rewritten. All 7 scripts parse clean (pwsh 7.6); helper smoke-tested on macOS against the dev DB: 181 KB verified dump, prune, corrupt-file rejection, status/log. Windows-only parts (Task Scheduler, rclone install, cmd /c) cannot run here — user to re-run setup.cmd.

tasks.title: Customer Communication & Campaign platform (email + WhatsApp wa.me first; SMS later): templates, engine, invoice send, birthday programme, stock alerts, campaigns
tasks.details:
EPIC. Design doc: docs/COMMUNICATION_PLATFORM.md (read it first). Spec from user 2026-09-14: one platform for ALL customer messages (invoices, birthday offer + wish, stock-availability alerts, festival/new-collection campaigns), provider-replaceable, A/B-ready, AI-ready later.

DECISIONS (user 2026-09-14): (1) epic R-62 + lettered sub-tickets; R-47 folded into R-62e; R-46 narrowed to Instagram publishing. (2) First channels = WhatsApp via wa.me click-to-chat (hand-off: system prepares text, staff taps Open WhatsApp and presses send) AND email (real send via SMTP), built together; SMS later. (3) Invoice auto-sends on every consented channel with contact info; WhatsApp shows the hand-off button on the POS close screen. (4) NO public URL: laptop stays LAN-only (internet out only) -> no links in messages, no webhooks, no hosted receipt page; status stops at SENT/HANDOFF.

ARCHITECTURE: business code calls ONE function enqueue(); rows go into delivery_logs (extended = the ledger AND the queue); an in-process worker polls (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) and sends through a provider chosen by env (COMM_EMAIL_PROVIDER=smtp, COMM_WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=wame|cloud, COMM_SMS_PROVIDER=none|msg91). Provider contract returns {kind:'sent'} or {kind:'handoff', url}. Daily scheduler (Asia/Kolkata, catch-up on late boot, idempotent via dedupe_key) drives birthdays + campaign steps. pg-boss considered and rejected (ledger row is the job).

PHASES: 1 = R-62a..g + i (platform, templates, engine, messages screen, invoice, birthday, stock alerts, preferences). 2 = R-62h campaigns + R-62j analytics. Later = R-62k WhatsApp Cloud API, R-62l SMS, R-62m PDF attachment, R-62n public receipt page + tunnel.

ORDER: a -> b -> c -> d -> e (first user-visible win: invoice on email + wa.me) -> f -> g -> i -> h -> j.

USER 2026-09-15: (1) Brevo account created -> email provider = Brevo SMTP. (2) Birthday wishes ALWAYS send (not an ad) - only do_not_contact blocks them; marketing opt-out does not. (3) Build the Customer Enquiry module first as its own ticket R-63 (a new Enquiries tab + table; creating an enquiry creates/picks the customer). R-62g now = auto-match + Notify on top of R-63.

humanQA.q:
**Which mailbox should IMPOC send email from?**

Needed before R-62c can be tested end-to-end (SMTP host, user, password go in `backend/.env`).

1. Brevo free plan (300 mails/day, needs a sender address you own)
2. Gmail with an app password (simplest; ~500/day cap)
3. Something else
humanQA.a: Brevo — account created (2026-09-15). SMTP creds to go in backend/.env when R-62c starts.

tasks.title: Comm foundation: migrations (comm_templates, delivery_logs extension, customers prefs, stock_inquiries, comm_campaigns/steps), models, permissions, settings keys
tasks.details: Migrations (ESM export style; rollback must work with db:refresh): (1) comm_templates (key+channel unique, category, subject, body, variables JSONB, is_active, is_system, archived_at, version). (2) ALTER delivery_logs: customer_id FK, template_key, template_version, category, campaign_id, campaign_step_id, variant_key, recipient, rendered_subject, rendered_body, scheduled_for, attempts, last_error, next_attempt_at, handoff_url, dedupe_key (unique partial), handed_off_at, confirmed_by_user_id; status check widened to QUEUED/SENDING/SENT/FAILED/HANDOFF/SKIPPED/CANCELLED/DELIVERED/READ; indexes (status,scheduled_for), (customer_id,created_at), (campaign_id). (3) customers: preferred_channel, marketing_opt_out_at, do_not_contact. (4) stock_inquiries. (5) comm_campaigns + comm_campaign_steps. (6) seed permissions comm.view, comm.send, comm.templates.manage, comm.campaigns.manage, comm.settings.manage (ADMIN+MANAGER; comm.send also CASHIER-type roles) following 20260905000008 pattern. (7) seed system templates (invoice, birthday_wish, birthday_offer, stock_available) for EMAIL + WHATSAPP with the spec's sample wording. Sequelize models + associations (Customer.hasMany DeliveryLog). Settings defaults in app-settings (comm.* keys, see design doc §3.6). Tests: migration up/down, model round-trip, dedupe_key uniqueness.

tasks.title: Templates: service + REST (create/edit/duplicate/archive/activate, render with {{variables}}, preview) + Templates admin screen
tasks.details: Backend src/modules/comm/templates.service.js: list/get/create/update/duplicate/archive/activate; render(templateKey, channel, variables) -> {subject, body}: {{var}} substitution, HTML-escape variables for EMAIL, leave template body trusted; missing variable -> render error listing the names; version++ on body/subject edit. tasks.title: Notification engine + provider layer: enqueue(), worker poller, retries, scheduler tick, providers email.smtp (nodemailer) + whatsapp.wame (hand-off) + none
tasks.details: engine/enqueue.js: the single entry point (see design doc §4): resolve customer -> channels = requested ∩ consent ∩ has contact − opt-out (marketing categories) − do_not_contact; normalise phone to E.164 (10 digits -> +comm.whatsapp.default_country_code); write one delivery_logs row per channel (QUEUED or SKIPPED with reason); honour dedupe_key (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING -> return existing). engine/worker.js: setInterval 20s, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 20, render -> provider.send -> SENT | HANDOFF(handoff_url) | FAILED; retry 3x (1m/10m/1h) when ProviderError.retryable; runOnce() exported for tests; disabled when NODE_ENV=test or COMM_WORKER=off; started from server.js after DB ready. engine/scheduler.js: hourly tick, runs 'daily jobs' once per Asia/Kolkata day (marker in app_settings comm.last_daily_run); job registry so R-62f/R-62h plug in. providers/: index.js picks by env; email.smtp.js via nodemailer (add dep) with SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS, from = comm.email.from_name <SMTP_FROM>; whatsapp.wame.js builds https://wa.me/<E164>?text=<encoded> and returns {kind:'handoff', url}; *.none.js -> SKIPPED 'provider not configured'. Global kill switch comm.enabled. REST: POST /api/comm/messages/:uuid/confirm-handoff (-> SENT, handed_off_at, confirmed_by), /undo-handoff (-> HANDOFF), /retry, /resend (clones row with new dedupe suffix). Tests: enqueue consent matrix, dedupe, worker runOnce with fake providers (sent/handoff/retryable/fatal), scheduler catch-up + once-per-day, phone normalisation. HUMAN: SMTP creds (see epic humanQA).

tasks.title: Messages screen (WhatsApp hand-off queue with Open WhatsApp, queued/sent/failed/skipped tabs, retry/resend) + Communication tab on customer profile

Tabs: To send on WhatsApp (rows in HANDOFF: customer, recipient, preview, Open WhatsApp button -> window.open(handoff_url) then POST confirm-handoff -> SENT; toast with Didn't send -> undo-handoff), Queued (scheduled_for), Sent, Failed (last_error, Retry), Skipped (reason). Tests: vitest for hand-off flow + undo, backend list filters.

tasks.title: Invoice communication: auto-enqueue receipt after sale/rental commit (email = branded HTML inline; WhatsApp = short text template + hand-off on POS close screen); resend from sale screen. Supersedes R-47
tasks.details: After createSale / createRental commit (NOT inside the tx; after-commit hook or right after tx resolves), call enqueue({templateKey:'invoice', entity:{SALE|RENTAL, uuid}, customerId, variables from buildReceipt payload, dedupeKey invoice:<TYPE>:<uuid>:<CHANNEL>}). Email body = buildReceiptHtml output embedded (template wraps it; subject 'Your SHREE receipt {{invoice_number}}'). WhatsApp body = invoice text template (number, date, N items, total ₹, thank you) - keep short for wa.me. POS PaymentDialog / close-transaction step: after Close transaction poll GET /api/comm/messages?entityUuid= and show chips: Email sent / WhatsApp: Open WhatsApp (hand-off inline, confirm on click) / Skipped: no consent; never block closing. Sale + rental detail screens: Send again button (channels picker). Cancel/refund: optional invoice_cancelled template (system, inactive by default). Idempotent on checkout retry via dedupe_key. Tests: backend enqueue on sale, no enqueue when comm.enabled=false, dedupe on retry; vitest for POS chips + hand-off.

tasks.title: Birthday programme: daily job (offer N days before, wish on the day), settings page (on/off, days before, validity, offer text, channels), due-soon preview
tasks.details: Scheduler job 'birthday' (registered in R-62c scheduler): at comm.send_hour Asia/Kolkata select customers with dob where (month,day) == today + days_before -> enqueue birthday_offer (variables customer_name, offer_text, valid_till = today+days_before+validity); (month,day)==today -> enqueue birthday_wish (mention offer only if an offer row exists this year). 29 Feb handled as 28 Feb in non-leap years. dedupe_key birthday_offer:<customer>:<year>:<CHANNEL> etc. Category RELATIONSHIP (respects marketing opt-out? NO - relationship messages are sent unless do_not_contact; document this). Admin -> Birthday programme screen (comm.settings.manage): toggle, days before, validity days, offer text, channels checkboxes, 'Due in next 14 days' list with customer + channel readiness (missing dob/consent shown as hints), 'Sent this year' counter. Manual 'Send now' per customer for the odd case. Tests: date maths incl. leap year and year boundary, idempotency, catch-up after late boot.

tasks.title: Enquiry "available" message through the real engine: route closeEnquiry(notify) via enqueue() + stock_available template; optional intake hint "N open enquiries asked for this product type"
tasks.details: DEPENDS ON R-63 + R-62c. User decision 2026-09-15: enquiries are closed manually only — NO auto-matching / auto-notify (a customer must never get "it is available" months later by accident). This ticket: (1) replace the R-63 hand-off links with enqueue({templateKey:'stock_available'}) so email really sends and WhatsApp goes through the Messages queue (or Cloud API later); (2) optional, low priority: on the add-unit / intake page show a hint "3 open enquiries mention <product type>" linking to the Enquiries tab filtered by that type (uses idx_customer_enquiries_open_product_type). See R-46 research for accounts/approvals timeline.

tasks.title: Customer Enquiry module: Enquiries tab (Open / Closed), customer_enquiries table, log an enquiry = pick or create the customer + what they want; close = "it's available — tell the customer" (tap-to-send WhatsApp / email / SMS) or "close quietly"
tasks.details:
USER: "we need a new tab where we note down the customer enquiries; one migration because we introduce a table; creating an enquiry is basically creating a new customer with the enquiry details." First building block of the stock-availability feature (R-62g adds matching + notify later).

SCOPE: migration 20260915000001 creates customer_enquiries (uuid, customer_id FK, product_type_id/colour_id/size_id nullable FKs, description NOT NULL, notes, promised_date DATEONLY, status OPEN|MATCHED|NOTIFIED|CLOSED (CHECK), matched_stock_id/matched_at/notified_at reserved for R-62g, closed_at/closed_reason (FULFILLED|NOT_AVAILABLE|CUSTOMER_DROPPED|OTHER)/closed_note/closed_by_user_id, created_by_user_id, soft delete, indexes (status, created_at), (customer_id), partial (product_type_id) WHERE status='OPEN'); migration 20260915000002 seeds enquiries.view / enquiries.create / enquiries.update (ADMIN, MANAGER, CASHIER). Backend module src/modules/enquiries: POST /api/enquiries accepts customerUuid OR an inline customer {name, phone, email, dob, consent*} (created in the same transaction; duplicate phone/email -> 409 so staff picks the existing one), GET list ?status&search (customer name/phone/description) with counts per status, GET :uuid, PATCH :uuid, POST :uuid/close {reason, note}, POST :uuid/reopen. Frontend: nav item Enquiries under POS / Counter (/enquiries), EnquiriesScreen with tabs Open / Closed + search + DataGrid (customer + phone, wanted = type · colour · size + description, promised date with Overdue badge, taken by, age, Edit / Close), EnquiryFormDialog = CustomerPicker (search or inline create - reuses the existing picker) + product type / colour / size Selects + description + notes + promised date; CloseEnquiryDialog with reason + note; enquiriesApi.js + routes + permission constants. Tests: backend (create with new customer, create with existing, 409 on duplicate phone, list filters + counts, close/reopen, permissions), vitest (screen list + tabs, form submit shape, close flow), navigation test updated.

NOT in scope (flagged): a separate WhatsApp number on the customer (customers has one phone + consent_whatsapp); POS 'log enquiry' shortcut; matching/notify (R-62g).

BUILT 2026-09-15 (awaiting user test): migrations 20260915000001 (customer_enquiries + CHECKs + indexes) and 20260915000002 (enquiries.view/create/update -> ADMIN, MANAGER, CASHIER), model CustomerEnquiry + associations; module src/modules/enquiries (validation/service/controller/routes) mounted at /api/enquiries; customers.service createCustomer now accepts { transaction } so the inline customer is created in the enquiry's transaction (duplicate phone/email -> 409, nothing saved). Frontend: ENQUIRY_ROUTES, PERMISSIONS.ENQUIRIES, services/enquiriesApi.js, screens/enquiries/{EnquiriesScreen,EnquiryFormDialog,CloseEnquiryDialog}.jsx, nav item 'Enquiries' under POS / Counter (icon MessageSquareText). Tests: jest tests/enquiries (11) + test-setup now builds the customers phone/email partial unique indexes (they were missing, so the 409 path was never exercised) + CASHIER permission assertions in auth.test updated; vitest enquiriesScreen (8) + navigation expectation. jest 764/764 (sales suite flaked once under parallel contention, green alone), vitest 434/434, build OK. Migrations applied on impoc_dev.

REWORKED 2026-09-15 after user feedback: enquiries close MANUALLY only, with exactly two outcomes — (a) "It's available — tell the customer": server builds the message (enquiries.notify.js, shop name from branding, first name, "Saree Red (free text)"), checks consent + contact per chosen channel (400 'Cannot reach the customer on WHATSAPP: No consent' otherwise), writes one delivery_logs row per channel (entity_type ENQUIRY, provider 'handoff', status SENT) and returns tap-to-send links: wa.me / mailto: / sms:; the dialog then shows one 'Open WhatsApp / Open email / Open SMS' button per link + Done. (b) "Close quietly": nothing sent. NO other close reasons (bought / not interested are not recorded — user: "we will not save any other details"). No auto-matching. Schema simplified: status OPEN|CLOSED, closed_reason NOTIFIED|NOT_NOTIFIED, notified_at + notified_channels; matched_* columns dropped (migration rewritten in place, re-applied on impoc_dev). DTO carries channelReadiness {WHATSAPP,EMAIL,SMS: {ok, reason}} so the dialog pre-ticks reachable channels and explains blocked ones; if none reachable the dialog defaults to quiet close. src/utils/phone.js toE164Digits (10-digit -> 91…) is the shared normaliser for R-62c. error.middleware allow-list gained the enquiry messages. Tests: jest enquiries 14 + phone 2 -> 769/769; vitest enquiriesScreen 10 -> 436/436; build OK.

WHEN R-62c LANDS: closeEnquiry() calls enqueue() with template 'stock_available' instead of building links; the dialog's hand-off step becomes the Messages queue (R-62d). Screen contract unchanged.

DONE 2026-09-15: user tested (log enquiry, close with tell-the-customer -> WhatsApp opened with the message) — "working".

tasks.title: Barcode generate/testsheet always streams a fresh PDF — never return cached/replayed result (user bug report 2026-09-16)
tasks.detail: USER: hitting GET /api/barcodes/generate?pages=5&requestUuid=... returned {"success":true,"message":"Barcode PDF generated (cached result)","data":{"resultUuid":...}} instead of a PDF download; "Waking the system up" banner then no file. Root cause: request_keys idempotency replay branch (barcode.controller.js) returns JSON marker and never streams the PDF; no route fetches a previous PDF by resultUuid. DECISION (user, 2026-09-16): option 2 — download any number of PDFs with the same template; never the cached/frozen PDF. Fix: drop replay for BARCODE_GENERATE + BARCODE_GENERATE_TEST (lookup pre-check, SequelizeUniqueConstraintError replay branch, RequestKey.create writes). Every request re-generates + streams fresh PDF. Update barcode.integration.test.js replay tests to expect fresh PDF. INTEGRATION: IMPOC folder only; run backend jest barcode + full suite.
